integrity: General theorem follows from exact simplicial pole decomposition, homological naturality, and rational transfer; finite checks corroborate only small parameters.
scientific_limitations: Integral homology of quotient, full quotient homotopy type, and equivariant wedge splitting not determined; unindexed equivalent may exist; finite verifier is not the infinite proof.
title: Reflection parity and quotient homology of nested-reversal tournament flag complexes
